title: Repair the evidenced nonprod readiness failure without bypassing gates
summary: Diagnosed terminal failure in Actions run 37006617043 during nonprod dev VM deployment under shared environment lease. Bound the actual failing check to verify_exact_component_deployment in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh where component paper-signal-producer was reported unhealthy. Discovered root cause: 9 legacy paper bindings on dev VM failed artifact loading due to schema mismatch ('lineage.source_dataset_refs: None is not of type array'). Reproduced in isolated process. Preserved strict gates and exact-artifact compensation. Added failure and recovery regression tests in scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py. Formulated specific evidence-backed coordinator action for dev VM database binding retirement.

inspected_run.failing_step: Deploy dev VM stack under lease
inspected_run.terminal_error: [remote-deploy] required component(s) unhealthy or unknown: paper-signal-producer: health=unhealthy
inspected_run.compensation_action: Sealed exact-artifact BFF restore succeeded and verified, safely reverting to prior baseline without activating candidate pair.

root_cause_analysis.mechanism: paper-signal-producer discovered 9 active paper bindings from runtime-manager (rb-8b36da8734534f298923e6fbb5f3eea7, rb-e3eafebeda57401b8ecdac6481e09fe7, rb-40419c598d5c436f9a735b3b7c5ccdf3, rb-9572f7b0cf9745c29ddafdc03cde136e, rb-b1f9532ba83043a3a8ef39ea95711f31, rb-8794cd13cdd649febc55c9957f0b3ba4, rb-d3a8e143ed464a40a7d26511c962c622, rb-69bfc2859ff14ff88a5006c78dcc4999, rb-30092281a9294185928793fd8d31761e). Each binding failed artifact loading with: 'Metadata schema validation failed at lineage.source_dataset_refs: None is not of type array'. The schema services/registry/lineage/promoted_artifact_metadata.schema.json requires lineage.source_dataset_refs to be an array, rejecting null. All 9 bindings degraded, setting health status to 'degraded'. check_worker_health in services/worker_health.py failed (exit 1) because status != 'ok', marking the container unhealthy.
root_cause_analysis.classification: Hosted configuration defect. The dev VM runtime-manager database and Object Store contain 9 historical legacy paper bindings from 2026-09-13 whose metadata carries source_dataset_refs: null.

disproven_hypotheses.observation: curl connection failure to 127.0.0.1:18789 and subsequent HTTP 503
disproven_hypotheses.disproof: Transient polling checks during scripts/openclaw-configure-shared-model-pool.sh while the gateway restarted after model-pool configuration. Both openclaw-gateway (port 18789) and openclaw-gateway-adapter (port 18104) were healthy (Up and healthy) prior to post-up verification gates.

disproven_hypotheses.observation: Historical snapshot failure from older run 36954831846
disproven_hypotheses.disproof: source-ingest was healthy and returned HTTP 200 OK for /api/source-ingest/snapshots/latest?symbol=SPY across all requests in run 37006617043.

isolated_reproduction.reproduced_error: Metadata schema validation failed at lineage.source_dataset_refs: None is not of type 'array'

guarantees: Unhealthy paper-signal-producer immediately fails closed, records verification failure in backend-components-receipt.json, and allows compensation restore rather than activating candidate pair.
Healthy paper-signal-producer passes gate, produces verified backend components receipt with status=passed and all_passed=true, admitting candidate pair.

Degraded binding caching under empty bindings (skipping producer.tick per paper_signal_producer.py:1123) and supported recovery procedures (restart container with clean state or replacement with valid active binding via lines 876-884) are substantiated and proven.

coordinator_action_required.action: Retire or clean up the 9 stale paper bindings on the dev VM via runtime-manager API (/api/runtime-bindings/<binding_id>/retire) or database cleanup, followed by paper-signal-producer container restart (or activating at least one valid active paper binding) so paper-signal-producer initializes/recovers with status: ok.
coordinator_action_required.external_hold: Preserve external hold with the existing release owner until genuine hosted remediation on the dev VM. Workers have no VM or SSH access, no Compose grant, no deployment trigger, and no second release lane. Diagnosis, regression tests, and fail-closed exact-artifact rollback are verified in source; hosted pair activation remains held until release coordinator executes binding retirement and restart on dev VM.
